svg.title: Happy birthday, Trap — Arcade's graffiti mural
svg.desc: 140 approved hand-painted covers by 140 people. Each painting includes its original birthday wish in its description.
svg.metadata: Snapshot 8293ad0adab0fd5a. Saved 2026-11-10T14:24:38.001Z. Original vector strokes; no external assets.

g.title: Fear
g.desc:
Happy birthday, my dearest friend. I've officially gone broke paying for this friendship subscription, but it's worth it. You're such a wonderful person, though I must confess, not always. Sometimes you're so loudly wrong and make such questionable decisions, especially that one time you decided to become friends with... me.
Jk, I'm the best and so are you. Have fun you lil goofball! 🎂

g.title: nuit_7
g.desc: Jazzyyyy my lovely wife this is ur 2nd birthday since our marriage which means that u have beeen a lovely friend and a wife through 2 years of my life looking for you to stay more than that and shine like the diamond you are i really hope you find all the best in life as you deserve ¡FELIZ CUMPLEAÑOS! ❤️❤️
